_nota: Editorial en inglés. construir.py exige una entrada por cada ciudad, región y circuito: si falta una, no genera nada. 'nombre' solo donde el inglés usa otro (Sevilla → Seville).
fuera: Galicia, Barcelona and the Costa del Sol are left out: each is more than 5 hours from Madrid one way, so two days would go on driving.

Madrid.ver: Start and finish (Puerta del Sol, km 0)

Ávila.ver: Walk on the city walls, Cathedral, convent of Saint Teresa

Salamanca.ver: Plaza Mayor, the University, both cathedrals, Casa de las Conchas

Zamora.ver: Cathedral, Romanesque churches, walls above the Douro

Valladolid.ver: National Sculpture Museum, Plaza Mayor, Cathedral

León.ver: Cathedral and its stained glass, San Isidoro, Barrio Húmedo, Casa Botines

Burgos.ver: Cathedral, Paseo del Espolón, Arch of Santa María

Lerma.ver: Plaza Ducal and the Ducal Palace

Soria.ver: San Juan de Duero, hermitage of San Saturio, Romanesque churches

Vitoria-Gasteiz.ver: Medieval quarter, Santa María Cathedral, Plaza de la Virgen Blanca

Getaria.ver: Harbour, church of San Salvador, txakoli wine

San Sebastián.ver: La Concha beach, Old Town and pintxos, Mount Urgull

Haro.ver: Barrio de la Estación and a winery visit

Laguardia.ver: Walled village, portico of Santa María, wineries

Logroño.ver: Calle Laurel, Co-cathedral of La Redonda, old town

Pamplona.ver: Old town, Plaza del Castillo, Cathedral, Citadel

Oviedo.ver: Cathedral, old town, pre-Romanesque churches of Mount Naranco

Gijón.ver: Cimadevilla, San Lorenzo beach, Universidad Laboral

Cangas de Onís.ver: Roman bridge and Covadonga (without going up to the Lakes)

Santander.ver: Magdalena Palace, El Sardinero, Centro Botín

Santillana del Mar.ver: Medieval village and Collegiate church (Altamira is separate)

San Vicente de la Barquera.ver: Old town, Puente de la Maza, views of the Picos de Europa

Córdoba.ver: Mosque-Cathedral, Jewish quarter, Alcázar of the Christian Monarchs

Carmona.ver: Puerta de Sevilla, old town, Roman necropolis

Sevilla.ver: Cathedral and Giralda, Royal Alcázar, Santa Cruz quarter, Plaza de España

Baeza.ver: Plaza del Pópulo, Cathedral, old University

Úbeda.ver: Plaza Vázquez de Molina, Sacra Capilla del Salvador

Granada.ver: Alhambra (timed entry, book ahead), Albaicín, Royal Chapel

Jaén.ver: Cathedral, Castle of Santa Catalina, Arab baths

Zafra.ver: Plaza Grande and Plaza Chica, Alcázar

Mérida.ver: Roman theatre and amphitheatre, National Museum of Roman Art, Roman bridge

Toledo.ver: Cathedral, Jewish quarter, Santo Tomé (El Greco), Alcázar

Almagro.ver: Plaza Mayor, Corral de Comedias theatre

Valencia.ver: Old town, Cathedral and Micalet tower, Silk Exchange, Central Market, City of Arts and Sciences

Alicante.ver: Santa Bárbara Castle, the Explanada, Santa Cruz quarter

Zaragoza.ver: Basilica del Pilar, La Seo, Aljafería

Teruel.ver: Mudéjar towers, Cathedral, the Lovers of Teruel
